data.description:
## Context / Problem

The plan-review engine switch (`[verify] plan_review_engine`, ADR 0123) is a temporary mechanism: two engines are kept side by side only until the comparison harness and production use show which one to keep. The mechanism-delta ratchet admits the switch's `config_key` only through a `mechanism-ok` marker that names a reason, and the parent epic requires that reason to be an OPEN ticket that stays open until an engine is retired. This is that ticket. It stays `open` (unclaimed) until the retirement decision is made, so the marker always points at live, unfinished work.

## Approach

When the operator decides which engine to keep, using the comparison harness report and the production verification recorded on the epic, delete the losing engine and the switch together, in one change: remove the `[verify] plan_review_engine` declaration and validation (`src/rebar/_config_schema.py`, `src/rebar/_config_sections.py`), its `mechanism-ok` marker, the `engine` argument on `review_plan` and the surfaces that pass it, the losing engine's workflow step in `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml`, and the losing engine's modules and tests. Run `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` in that change and commit the shrunken baseline (AGENTS.md: removal always passes and the drain is the sanctioned path). Attestations keep their recorded `engine` field, so historical provenance survives. Deleting the switch with the losing engine, rather than leaving a one-valued key, is what retires the mechanism the marker admitted.

## Scope

- src/rebar/_config_schema.py, src/rebar/_config_sections.py (key removal)
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py (engine argument removal)
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml (losing engine's step removal)
- the losing engine's modules and tests (the 4-pass pipeline's `orchestrator.py`/`passes.py`/`pass1.py` family, or the agentic engine module)
- rebar.toml, docs/config.md, docs/adr/0123-selectable-plan-review-engine.md (status amended to record the retirement)
- .github/mechanism-baseline.json (stale entry drained)

## Testing

- The retained engine's existing tests pass unchanged; the switch tests are deleted with the switch.
- A config file still carrying `plan_review_engine` is a load error naming the removed key, pinned by a config test, so a stale setting is not silently ignored.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `git grep -nF plan_review_engine -- src rebar.toml docs/config.md` prints nothing.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0 after the stale drain.
- [ ] ADR 0123 records which engine was retired and why, citing the comparison and production evidence on the epic.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Retire one plan-review engine and remove the engine switch (sunset; stays open until retirement)
